T+00:00:00 · IGNITION

Why Bharat Vigyan Yatra exists

India's first science show in the tradition of the Royal Institution, UK — a movement to ignite scientific temper and build Viksit Bharat 2047. Mentor-led storytelling, live experiments and space education for every classroom in the country.

🧪

Live Experiments

Real demonstrations on stage — not just slides — so students see science happen.

🎤

Inspiring Talks

Mentors and scientists share stories that make big ideas feel personal.

🔭

Space & Astronomy

From sky-watching to ISRO missions — India's place in the cosmos, explained.

💡

Innovation & Creativity

Turning curiosity into projects, prototypes and problem-solving.

🎯

Mission

Make world-class science learning accessible to every student, in Hindi and English, regardless of geography or income.

🔭

Vision

A Bharat where scientific curiosity is a daily habit — from village schools to national research labs.

🚀

The Journey

From a single classroom pilot to a nationwide movement spanning 620+ schools and 18,000+ learners.

🇮🇳

Viksit Bharat 2047

Every episode ties classroom science to India's innovation goals for its 100th year of independence.

🧠

Scientific Temper

We teach students to question, test and reason — not just memorise formulae.

🌍

SDG Alignment

Programming mapped to UN SDG 4 (Quality Education) and SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure).

"

Every child who has ever looked up at the night sky and wondered "what's out there" is a scientist in the making. Bharat Vigyan Yatra exists because that spark deserves more than a textbook — it deserves a stage, an experiment, and someone who believes in it. We started this with a microphone and a few flasks; today it's a movement carrying that same curiosity into every school we can reach.

ST Ali Founder, Bharat Vigyan Yatra

T+00:38:20 · Q&A LOOP

Frequently asked questions

Is Bharat Vigyan Yatra free for schools? +
Core episodes and quizzes are free for all registered schools. Premium modules like the Innovation Challenge and Olympiad certification have a nominal fee.
Which languages are supported? +
All episodes and the AI Science Assistant are available in Hindi and English, with more regional languages planned.
How do students get certificates? +
Certificates are auto-generated with a unique ID and QR verification after completing an episode series or quiz.
Can individual students join without a school? +
Yes — students can register directly through the Student Portal using email or mobile OTP login.
